name: hister
title: Hister
description: Full-text search of the web pages and files indexed by your Hister instance.
author: tommasoturchi

commands.name: search-hister
commands.title: Search History
commands.subtitle: Hister
commands.description: Search indexed pages by content and open results in your browser.

preferences.name: serverUrl
preferences.title: Server URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your Hister instance, including any base path

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Needed only if your server requires authentication: the app.access_token value, or the output of hister user show USERNAME --show-token

preferences.name: fallbackSearchUrl
preferences.title: Web Search URL
preferences.description: Used by Search the Web; %s is replaced by the query

preferences.name: semantic
preferences.title: Semantic Search
preferences.label: Include semantic matches
preferences.description: Adds a Similar Pages section. Requires an embeddings endpoint configured in Hister.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
